prompt: On the board StickHub.kicad_pcb in this folder, move the four logo footprints LOGO1, LOGO2, LOGO3 and LOGO4 down by exactly 1 mm (+1 mm in Y, X unchanged) and set J9's rotation to 90 degrees. Change nothing else, and save the board.

In this folder's schematic (pic_programmer.kicad_sch and its sub-sheet pic_sockets), change the value of the seven 10K resistors R1 to R7 to `10k` and give each of them a field `MPN` with the value `RC0603FR-0710KL`. Change C6 and C7 (they are on the pic_sockets sheet) to the value `100n` with `MPN` = `CC0603KRX7R9BB104`. Change nothing else, and save the schematic.

Add a net class `USB` to the StickHub project in this folder: clearance 0.15 mm, track width 0.2 mm, differential pair width 0.2 mm, differential pair gap 0.18 mm. Assign nets to it with these four patterns, in this order: `/U*D+`, `/U*D-`, `/D+`, `/D-`. Change nothing else, and save.

On the root sheet of pic_programmer.kicad_sch in this folder, add a test point: the library symbol `Connector:TestPoint`, reference `TP1`, value `CLK`, at (250.19, 60.96) mm, not rotated. Its pin is at the symbol's position: draw a wire from there straight down to (250.19, 66.04) mm and put a local label `PC-CLOCK-OUT` at (250.19, 66.04) mm, so TP1 is on that net. Change nothing else, and save the schematic.

On the board StickHub.kicad_pcb in this folder, add a track on B.Cu on net GND, 0.25 mm wide, from (157.25, 100.25) mm to (157.25, 98.5) mm, and a through via on net GND at (157.25, 98.5) mm with diameter 0.6 mm and drill 0.3 mm. Change nothing else, and save the board.

On the board StickHub.kicad_pcb in this folder, there is one copper zone on net +1V8. Set its clearance to 0.2 mm and its minimum width to 0.2 mm, name it `PWR_1V8`, and refill it. Change nothing else, and save the board.

Add two custom design rules to the StickHub board in this folder: `usb_clearance`, a clearance of at least 0.2 mm where `A.NetClass == 'USB'`; and `hv_cap_courtyard`, a courtyard clearance of at least 0.5 mm where `A.Reference == 'C38'`. Change nothing else, and save.

DRC on the board StickHub.kicad_pcb in this folder reports violations, and all of them come from one stray track segment that was added by mistake. Run DRC, find that segment, delete it (only it), save the board, and confirm that DRC is clean.
